checks: 01 The startup screen shows before the window is built (graphite 83%, paper 14% of its pixels), frameless and centred, stays while the window is built and closes when the window is shown

02 The head's mark is the sharpened point on a graphite tile (1524 graphite, 239 paper pixels) named Graphite; one click on it opens the STRUTHIO game (struthio_qt.show called once with the window, patched)

03 The cat stands at the lower-left of the strip with no word beside it; tooltip and accessible name Open menu (the accessible description keeps the service summary, the menu's choices and the F1 note after a lifecycle render); 85 by 44 px at 14 pt
04 Pointer events: away from the cat it rests; on it the cat gives the side-eye with the tail's question-mark curl, paws down

05 One click opens the existing menu at once in the open pose; the open pose holds with the pointer on the menu and back on the cat (precedence over hover); on close the pointer over the cat gives hover, away gives rest

06 With the menu closed and no input for the (patched) 0.5 s the cat is sleepy; a key typed elsewhere keeps it asleep and restarts the timer; hover wakes it into the side-eye; from sleep one click opens the menu in the open pose

07 Space and Enter on the focused cat open the menu with its first row (Work) active, in the open pose; Escape closes it, focus returns to the cat, and with the pointer away it rests; keyboard focus turns the edge eraser pink (180 px)
08 A pose change moves the numbers in one short animation (150 ms; the tail rose through 7 sampled steps); under reading.reduce_motion the pose switches directly with no animation
09 The four poses drawn large by the button's own painter, beside the reference layout
10 At 1366 by 768 the cat rests at the lower left, hovers and opens the menu with one click, every strip word whole (tools/ui_fit); at 20 pt it is 62 px high (the 1.4 cap)
11 No job, worker, model, provider request, process, shell command or detached program; clean close removed the lease

captures.note: The startup screen launch.main shows before the window is built: graphite ground, the sharpened point in paper, GRAPHITE in spaced capitals below; frameless and centred; no fade.
The head at 1920 by 1200, left end, enlarged 2x: the sharpened point on a small graphite tile in place of the bird (tooltip and accessible name Graphite). The wordmark beside it is the rename item's.

The tile at 16, 24 and 32 px (the window icon's small entries) and 44 px (the head), each pixel enlarged 6x: the gap between the wedges reads and the stroke is solid; at 16 px the stroke is left out rather than drawn as a smudge.
REST: eyes forward, both paws on the edge, tail tucked away (window crop, 4x).
1920 by 1200: the cat at rest at the lower-left of the typing strip, unlabeled.
HOVER: a quick side-eye; the tail rises in a question-mark curl that is part of the tail (no separate dot); both paws down.
MENU OPEN: the tail out of sight, the right paw lifted as if bringing the menu up, the eyes toward it.
1920 by 1200: one click on the cat opened the existing menu at once; the cat holds the open pose.
SLEEPY: after a stretch without input (shortened to 0.5 s for the check), the head a little lower and the eyes closed.
1920 by 1200 with the cat asleep at the lower left.
Keyboard focus on the cat: the edge it peeks over turns eraser pink.
The four poses at 220 px, drawn by graphite_brand.paint_cat, the painter the button uses; laid out like the owner's reference sheet (branding/graphite/reference/).
1366 by 768: the cat at rest at the lower left; the strip's words beside it.
1366 by 768: the menu opened by one click on the cat, which holds the open pose.
At 20 pt interface text the cat is 62 px high (the 1.4 cap), enlarged 2x.

names.accessible_description: New work enabled · Tools by group · Explore the workshop · New Idea · New Project · Graphite services On / Off / Reboot · leave Graphite · F1 reads the highlighted row into the typing-bar note.

decisions.poses: pure CatPoses: open > sleepy > hover > rest; hover and the menu wake; input elsewhere restarts the inactivity timer without waking (movement tied to interaction)
decisions.motion: one QVariantAnimation of MOVE_MS over six pose numbers; Reduce motion sets the numbers at once
decisions.startup: QSplashScreen from launch.main before qt_app is imported; closed by the first other window shown; no fade
